label: christmasfive3
title_zh: Thaum 的遗产·第六部：思维之镜

lines.en: label christmasfive3:
scene mroomdnd1
: ...and thus the battle raged on!
lines.zh: : ……战斗就这样继续激战着!

lines.en: : It’s been raging on for hours now! I want to go to sleep!
lines.zh: : 已经打了几个小时了!我想睡觉!

lines.en: : Muffled by the sounds of dirt and gravel, Nithhala’s voice is unable to reach Der Krampus! And, with a whip of his tail, he sends a shockwave through the air that deals 5 points of damage to everyone!
lines.zh: : 被泥土和碎石的声响盖住,Nithhala 的声音传不到 Der Krampus 那里!接着,他尾巴一甩,在空中激出一道冲击波,对所有人造成 5 点伤害!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd2
: Or...everyone {i}but{/i} Nithhala, I suppose. She manages to avoid it since she’s currently lying face down in the soil.
lines.zh: : 或者……{i}除了{/i} Nithhala 以外的所有人,我想。她躲过了,因为她这会儿正脸朝下趴在土里。

lines.en: : Hooraaaaaay.
scene mroomdnd3
: Perhaps the problem is that we’re trying to fight the Krampus at all? Maybe if we banded together and taught him the true meaning of Christmas, he’d be more reluctant to hurt us?
lines.zh: : 也许问题在于我们根本就不该跟 Krampus 打?要是我们团结起来,教会他圣诞节的真正意义,他也许就不太愿意伤害我们了?

lines.en: : Sensing a sickening feeling of hope and splendor, Der Krampus changes targets and sets his sight on Xessaxia!
lines.zh: : 察觉到一阵令人作呕的希望与光辉,Der Krampus 换了个目标,把目光锁定在 Xessaxia 身上!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd4
: What?! But it’s not even his turn! And Zagull has done far more to provoke him than I have! Isn’t that right, Zagull?!
lines.zh: : 什么?!可现在根本不是他的回合啊!而且 Zagull 比我更招惹他!我说得对吧,Zagull?!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd5
: Zagull?
lines.zh: : Zagull?

lines.en: scene mroomdnd6
: Hm? What?
lines.zh: : 嗯?什么?

lines.en: scene mroomdnd1
: As Der Krampus gazes at the satyr’s voluptuous and somewhat goat-ish figure, he chuckles to himself, reaching into his burlap sack and removing a tiny snowglobe.
lines.zh: : Der Krampus 打量着萨堤尔那丰腴、又有点像山羊的身段,暗自低笑一声,把手伸进粗麻袋,掏出一个小小的雪花球。

lines.en: : With the globe in one hand and a large, birch rod in the other, a snarl crawls across his face — a yellowish snaggletooth peeking outward as he speaks.
lines.zh: : 他一手拿着雪花球,一手握着一根粗大的桦木枝条,狞笑爬上他的脸——说话时,一颗发黄的龅牙探了出来。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd7
: Have you been a good girl?...Or have you been a {i}bad{/i} girl?
lines.zh: : 你是个好女孩吗?……还是个{i}坏{/i}女孩?

lines.en: : Just say it, Futaba. It’s clear this fight isn’t going to end until we play along with whatever this Krampus guy wants. So just satisfy Molly’s secret fetish to hear you call yourself a good and/or bad girl.
lines.zh: : 你就说吧,Futaba。很明显,不顺着这个 Krampus 的意思来,这场战斗就不会结束。所以就满足一下 Molly 那个隐秘的癖好吧,让她听听你说自己是好女孩还是坏女孩。

lines.en: : It is for Der Krampus, not me.
lines.zh: : 这是为了 Der Krampus,不是为了我。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd8
: I’ve been a bad girl.
lines.zh: : 我是个坏女孩。

lines.en: : Wha- no. Ram, Der Krampus is speaking to Xessaxia right now.
lines.zh: : 什——不对。Ram,Der Krampus 现在是在跟 Xessaxia 说话。

lines.en: : I’ve been a very, {i}very{/i} bad girl.
lines.zh: : 我是个非常、{i}非常{/i}坏的女孩。

lines.en: : You’d crawl right back to your hole if you only knew the things I’ve done with ghosts.
lines.zh: : 你要是知道我和幽灵都做过些什么,准会立马爬回你的洞里去。

lines.en: : {i}What?{/i} You’re a bard, not a warlock. What do ghosts have do with anything?
lines.zh: : {i}什么{/i}?你是吟游诗人,又不是术士。幽灵跟这有什么关系?

lines.en: scene mroomdnd9
: Nithhala gets up.
lines.zh: : Nithhala 站起来了。

lines.en: : Nithhala can’t get up unless she succeeds on her death saving rolls or is helped by an ally.
lines.zh: : Nithhala 站不起来,除非她的死亡豁免检定成功,或者有队友帮忙。

lines.en: : She does it anyway. It’s a Christmas miracle.
lines.zh: : 她还是站起来了。这是圣诞奇迹。

lines.en: : Damn it. I forgot I added that mechanic into tonight’s game. Fine. Nithhala is no longer downed. But her Christmas miracle is on cooldown for the next 365 days.
lines.zh: : 该死。我忘了自己往今晚的游戏里加了这个机制。行吧。Nithhala 不再处于倒地状态。但她的圣诞奇迹要冷却 365 天。

lines.en: : What does Nithhala do next?
lines.zh: : Nithhala 接下来要做什么?

lines.en: : Leaves.
lines.zh: : 走人。

lines.en: : Nithhala turns her back to Der Krampus in an effort to escape, prompting him take an opportunity attack against her!
lines.zh: : Nithhala 背对 Der Krampus 想要逃跑,这让他对她发动了一次借机攻击!

lines.en: : With one hand still holding tightly onto the snowglobe, Der Krampus uses his other to swing his birch rod at Nithhala!
lines.zh: : Der Krampus 一只手仍紧紧攥着雪花球,另一只手挥起桦木枝条朝 Nithhala 抽去!

lines.en: : With a violent crack, it snaps against the back of her neck for fifteen points of damage! She’s downed again!
lines.zh: : 伴随着一声脆响,枝条狠狠抽在她后颈上,造成十五点伤害!她又倒下了!

lines.en: : Ugh! Really? My Christmas miracle didn’t even bring me back to full HP?! That’s no miracle! That’s a lucky coincidence.
lines.zh: : 呃!真的假的?我的圣诞奇迹甚至没让我恢复到满 HP?!这算什么奇迹!这叫走运。

lines.en: : Fine. I’ll play along. Xessaxia steps toward Der Krampus and seductively raises her eyebrow at him. {i}I’ve been a very good girl, Mr. Krampus...don’t you believe me?...{/i}she says.
lines.zh: : 行吧。我配合就是。Xessaxia 朝 Der Krampus 走近一步,挑起眉毛,风情万种地看着他。「{i}我一直是个很好的女孩,Krampus 先生……您不信吗?……{/i}」她说道。

lines.en: : Are you trying to seduce him?...
lines.zh: : 你是在试图勾引他吗?……

lines.en: : I don’t know what I’m supposed to do! This fight keeps dragging on and on no matter what we do and he doesn’t look any weaker than he did when we started!
lines.zh: : 我不知道我该怎么办!不管我们做什么,这场战斗就这么没完没了地拖下去,而且他看上去一点都不比刚开始时弱!

lines.en: : I wish Ami and Maya were here. Molly probably forgot to re-tune the fight to compensate for our missing party members.
lines.zh: : 真希望 Ami 和 Maya 在。Molly 大概是忘了重新调整战斗难度,来弥补我们缺少的队员。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd10
: False. Arborea and Racerrk have been separated from the party for several sessions now and won’t be able to return until they restore order in the Western Sanctum.
lines.zh: : 不对。Arborea 和 Racerrk 已经脱离队伍好几个场次了,在他们恢复西部圣所的秩序之前,他们是回不来的。

lines.en: : What happened to Urrheak?
lines.zh: : Urrheak 怎么了?

lines.en: : He’s been dead since last Christmas, Ram. Racerrk is his long-lost child who has dedicated his life to avenging his father. How many times must you be reminded of this?
lines.zh: : 他从去年圣诞节起就死了,Ram。Racerrk 是他失散多年的孩子,毕生都在为父亲复仇。这件事要提醒你多少次?

lines.en: : If Urrheak is the father, who is the mother?
lines.zh: : 如果 Urrheak 是父亲,那母亲是谁?

lines.en: scene mroomdnd11
: Oh! Lidearel!
lines.zh: : 哦!Lidearel!

lines.en: : What an unexpected plot twist. This is why you are the master of dungeons, Emerald Guardian.
lines.zh: : 真是出人意料的剧情反转。这就是你被称为地下城主的原因啊,翡翠守护者。

lines.en: : What? No. Lidearel isn’t the mother. I was merely rejoicing at the fact that she has finally arrived.
lines.zh: : 什么?不是。Lidearel 不是母亲。我只是在为她终于到了这件事高兴。

lines.en: : Even the plot twist has a twist to it. I am on the edge of my seat.
lines.zh: : 连剧情反转都能再反转一次。我现在紧张得坐不住了。

lines.en: : Sorry for the holdup, everyone. Touka and her mom showed up at Sensei’s place, so I wound up getting roped into teaching them about regular people again.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让大家久等了。Touka 和她妈妈跑到 Sensei 家去了,结果我又被拉去教她们「普通人」是怎么回事。

lines.en: : I brought ice cream, though. And energy drinks for anyone who wants them. What’d I miss?
lines.zh: : 不过我带了冰淇淋。还有功能饮料,谁想要就拿。我错过了什么?

lines.en: scene mroomdnd12
: The birth of your child, you heathen.
lines.zh: : 你孩子的诞生,你这异教徒。

lines.en: : Wow. I didn’t realize I’d been gone {i}that{/i} long.
lines.zh: : 哇。我没想到自己离开了{i}那么{/i}久。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd13
: What happened to Rin? Is she asleep already?
lines.zh: : Rin 怎么了?她已经睡了吗?

lines.en: : No, but I {i}should{/i} be! This is the longest fight of my life. And I dated Otoha for like a whole year, so that’s saying something.
lines.zh: : 没有,不过我{i}真该{/i}睡了!这是我这辈子最长的一场战斗。而且我跟 Otoha 交往了差不多整整一年,所以这话很有分量。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd14
: Well, what are we fighting {i}against{/i} exactly? Another one of Thaum’s emissaries? Or did Zagull just accidentally start another bar fight?
lines.zh: : 那么,我们到底在{i}跟{/i}什么打?又是 Thaum 的某个使者?还是 Zagull 又不小心挑起了一场酒吧斗殴?

lines.en: : We’re locked in a heated battle with Der Crumpet.
lines.zh: : 我们正和 Der Crumpet 打得难解难分。

lines.en: : {i}Krampus,{/i} Kendo Princess. Crumpets are an English pastry.
lines.zh: : 是 {i}Krampus{/i},剑道公主。Crumpet 是一种英式点心。

lines.en: : That makes him all the more threatening. Everyone knows how bad English food is.
lines.zh: : 那他就更有威胁性了。谁都知道英国菜有多难吃。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd15
: That...
: You don’t...
lines.zh: : 你别……

lines.en: scene mroomdnd16
: S-Silence! I have to fill Lidearel in on what she’s missed out on!
lines.zh: : 闭——闭嘴!我得给 Lidearel 补一补她错过的剧情!

lines.en: : We showed up for a festival. Der Crumpet popped out. Now Futaba is trying to fuck him.
lines.zh: : 我们来参加节日。Der Crumpet 蹦了出来。现在 Futaba 正想操他。

lines.en: : Not even close, Nithhala!
lines.zh: : 差得远呢,Nithhala!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd17
: {i}Xessaxia{/i} is trying to fuck him.
lines.zh: : 是 {i}Xessaxia{/i} 想操他。

lines.en: : I wonder...what it would be like...with a satyr...
lines.zh: : 我在想……跟萨堤尔……会是什么感觉……

lines.en: : If you’re truly curious, I can forward you several {i}resources{/i} once the game comes to a close. But for now, the recap is as such-
lines.zh: : 如果你真好奇,等这场游戏结束,我可以给你转发几份「{i}资料{/i}」。不过现在,剧情回顾是这样的——

lines.en: scene mroomdnd18
: With Racerrk and Arborea currently tying up Urrheak’s loose ends in the Western Sanctum, the remainder of the party has decided to take it easy for the time being.
lines.zh: : 由于 Racerrk 和 Arborea 眼下正在西部圣所替 Urrheak 收拾残局,队伍余下的人决定暂时放松一下。

lines.en: : Or at least that was the {i}intention.{/i}
lines.zh: : 至少原本是这么{i}打算{/i}的。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd19
: Upon hearing the news of an annual holiday festival in a nearby town, you’ve taken up residence at their inn and have decided to spend the winter {i}there{/i} as you await your friends.
lines.zh: : 听闻附近小镇要举办一年一度的节日庆典,你们便在当地的旅店住下,决定在{i}那里{/i}过冬,等着同伴们回来。

lines.en: : To fill both the lull in time and the abyss that has become your coffers, you’ve accepted several commissions from locals. But there was {i}one{/i} commission in particular that sounded far too good to be true.
lines.zh: : 为了打发这段空档,也为了填补已经见了底的钱包,你们接下了当地人的几份委托。但其中有{i}那么一份{/i}委托,听起来好得简直不像真的。

lines.en: : And, as I’m sure you know, when something sounds too good to be true, it is almost always because it {i}is.{/i}
lines.zh: : 而我相信你们也知道,一件事听起来好得不像真的,几乎总是因为它{i}确实{/i}不是真的。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd20
: The mission — decorate a market stall to prepare for the holiday festival! The reward — 10 gold pieces each.
lines.zh: : 任务——装饰一个市场摊位,为节日庆典做准备!报酬——每人 10 枚金币。

lines.en: : The outcome — some Christmas demon wants to kill us now.
lines.zh: : 结果——现在有个圣诞恶魔想杀了我们。

lines.en: : That is essentially true, yes.
lines.zh: : 大体上确实如此。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd21
: He popped out from behind the stall once we showed up to decorate it.
lines.zh: : 我们一来准备装饰摊位,他就从摊位后面蹦了出来。

lines.en: : Now he won’t let us go until we defeat him. But he refuses to actually {i}kill{/i} us and just keeps downing us before healing us himself.
lines.zh: : 现在他不打赢他就不放我们走。可他又死活不肯真的{i}杀{/i}了我们,只是一遍遍把我们打倒,然后再亲自把我们治好。

lines.en: : And now you’re...trying to have sex with him?
lines.zh: : 那你现在……是想跟他上床?

lines.en: scene mroomdnd22
: Only because he looked like he was going to kill me when I tried to teach him about Christmas! It’s not like I {i}want{/i} to spend 2:00 AM roleplaying a satyr making love to Der Krampus!
lines.zh: : 只是因为我想教他圣诞节的意义时,他一副要杀了我的样子!我又不是{i}想{/i}在凌晨两点扮演一个萨堤尔跟 Der Krampus 做爱!

lines.en: : I’ll do it if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : 你不想的话我来。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd23
: For the party, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是为了队伍。

lines.en: : That solves nothing!
lines.zh: : 这解决不了任何问题!

lines.en: : We won’t know that until we try.
lines.zh: : 不试试怎么知道。

lines.en: : I will inform you now that Der Krampus does not intend to have sex with anyone tonight.
lines.zh: : 我现在就告诉你们,Der Krampus 今晚不打算跟任何人上床。

lines.en: : We really won’t know that until we try, though.
lines.zh: : 不过不试试,我们是真的不会知道的。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd24
: Do you have any thoughts on how to tackle this, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo,你有什么对付他的想法吗?

lines.en: : I have already tried to tackle it. The attempt resulted in me being thrown into a nearby fountain. But as your character is a rogue and not a bard, it is possible you will have more success.
lines.zh: : 我已经试过了。结果是我被扔进了附近的喷泉里。不过你的角色是游荡者而不是吟游诗人,说不定你会更走运。

lines.en: : He’s also holding a snowglobe thingy. Molly drew a lot of attention to it twice now, so it’s probably important in some way.
lines.zh: : 他还拿着一个雪花球之类的东西。Molly 已经两次刻意强调它了,所以它在某种程度上大概挺重要。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd25
: The snowglobe is merely a diversion. We all know the true evil in this battle lies within British cuisine. Ram summons celebrity chef, Gordon Ramsay. How many dice must I roll to do this?
lines.zh: : 雪花球不过是个障眼法。我们都知道这场战斗真正的邪恶在于英国料理。Ram 召唤名厨 Gordon Ramsay。我需要掷几个骰子才能做到?

lines.en: : None. Der Krampus laid out an anti-Ramsay forcefield before the battle started.
lines.zh: : 一个都不用。Der Krampus 在战斗开始前就布下了反 Ramsay 力场。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd26
: Damn it. He’s thought of everything.
lines.zh: : 该死。他把什么都想到了。

lines.en: : Lidearel knows he’s holding this snowglobe thing? She can see it?
lines.zh: : Lidearel 知道他拿着这个雪花球?她能看见它?

lines.en: : Correct. The globe is visible to all of you and about the same size as a human head.
lines.zh: : 没错。那个球你们所有人都看得见,大小跟人的脑袋差不多。

lines.en: : Got it. Then, whose turn is it now and when do I come in?
lines.zh: : 明白了。那么,现在轮到谁了,我什么时候上场?

lines.en: : You’ll enter combat after Zagull Throat Spear, who takes his turn next. I rolled initiative for you prior to your arrival and have been acting in your place since.
lines.zh: : 你在 Zagull Throat Spear 之后进入战斗,下一个就是他的回合。你到场之前我就替你掷了先攻,之后一直由我代你行动。

lines.en: : Gotcha. I’ll just wait until Sana is done then.
lines.zh: : 懂了。那我就等 Sana 结束好了。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd27
: So it’s my turn now? Did I hear that right?
lines.zh: : 那现在是我的回合了?我没听错吧?

lines.en: : Yes. But keep in mind that you’re still currently paralyzed from the waist down due to-
lines.zh: : 是的。不过别忘了,你现在腰部以下仍然处于麻痹状态,因为——

lines.en: scene mroomdnd28
: HEY, FUCKBOY!
lines.zh: : 喂,混账小子!

lines.en: : Oh, dear. Here we go again.
lines.zh: : 哦,天哪。又来了。

lines.en: : YOU THINK JUST BECAUSE I CAN’T MOVE MY LEGS THAT I WON’T POUND THAT KRAMPUSSY INTO OBLIVION?!
lines.zh: : 你以为我腿动不了,就不会把那个 KRAMPUSSY 干到渣都不剩吗?!

lines.en: : YOU’VE CROSSED THE PATH OF ZAGULL THROAT SPEAR, DEMON BITCH! AND THE MOMENT THIS PARALYSIS WEARS OFF, I’M SHOVING THAT BIRCH ROD UP YOUR GODDAMN-
lines.zh: : 你惹上了 ZAGULL THROAT SPEAR,恶魔婊子!等这麻痹一消退,我他妈就把那根桦木枝条捅进你的——

lines.en: scene mroomdnd29
: Huh?...Why are you rolling?...What happened?...
lines.zh: : 啊?……你在掷什么?……发生什么了?……

lines.en: : Hm? Oh, nothing. You just took another twenty points of psychic damage from Der Krampus’ “Thought Mirror.” Your arms are paralyzed as well now. Err...sorry. {i}Arm.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯?哦,没什么。你只是又受到了 Der Krampus「思维之镜」造成的二十点心灵伤害。现在你的手臂也麻痹了。呃……抱歉。是{i}一条手臂{/i}。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd30
: What the heck is “Thought Mirror?!”
lines.zh: : 「思维之镜」到底是什么鬼?!

lines.en: : The same ability he used against you the {i}last{/i} time you tried shouting at him. It’s why your legs are paralyzed, Sana.
lines.zh: : 就是{i}上次{/i}你冲他吼时他对你用的那个能力。你的腿就是这么麻的,Sana。

lines.en: : How did you even forget something that only happened like ten minutes ago?
lines.zh: : 十分钟前才发生的事,你居然都能忘?

lines.en: scene mroomdnd31
: YOU’D DAMN WELL KNOW THE ANSWER TO THAT IF YOU WERE IN MY SHOES!!!!
lines.zh: : 你要是站在我的位置上,他妈的早就知道答案了!!!!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd9
: STOP YELLING! I WAS ABOUT TO FALL ASLEEP!
lines.zh: : 别喊了!我差点就睡着了!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd32
: NO ONE SLEEPS UNTIL DER CRUMP...{i}KRAMPUS{/i} IS DEFEATED!
lines.zh: : 在 DER CRUMP……{i}KRAMPUS{/i} 被打倒之前,谁都不许睡!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd33
: I AM ALSO YELLING NOW!
lines.zh: : 我现在也在喊了!

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} am going to use Sleight of Hand to try and steal that snowglobe thing now that Zagull is fully paralyzed.
lines.zh: : 既然 Zagull 全身都麻痹了,{i}我{/i}要用巧手试着偷走那个雪花球。

lines.en: : ROLL FOR D- {i}Ahem.{/i} Roll for dexterity.
lines.zh: : 掷骰决定——{i}咳{/i}。掷敏捷检定。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd34
: Kachow. Natural 20.
lines.zh: : 咔嚓。天然 20。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd1

: Distracted by the curvaceous figure of the female satyr and {i}elated{/i} by Zagull Throat Spear’s full-body paralysis, Der Krampus doesn’t even notice Lidereal as she makes a break for the snowglobe!
lines.zh: : Der Krampus 被女性萨堤尔那曼妙的身段分了神,又为 Zagull Throat Spear 全身麻痹而{i}得意{/i},以至于 Lidereal 冲向雪花球时,他根本没注意到!

lines.en: : The speed at which she moves almost makes it seem as if she’s fading in and out of existence!
lines.zh: : 她移动的速度快得几乎像是正在时隐时现!

lines.en: : Visible to no one but her, a set of red, feathery wings blossom out of her spine- but disappear just as quickly as they formed!
lines.zh: : 除了她自己,没人看得见:一对红色的羽翼从她的脊柱上绽放开来——却又在成形的一瞬间消失了!

lines.en: : It isn’t until she begins to scale the demon’s body that he notices her presence! But, by the time he does, it’s already too late!
lines.zh: : 直到她开始顺着恶魔的身体往上爬,他才察觉到她的存在!可等他察觉时,已经太迟了!

lines.en: scene mroomdnd35
: She leaps backward — clutching the snowglobe with both hands. It seems gigantic in her possession when, just moments ago, the demon made it seem so small.
lines.zh: : 她双手紧抱着雪花球向后跃开。就在片刻之前,那恶魔还让它显得那么小,如今到了她手里却显得格外巨大。

lines.en: : She gazes into the globe- and among the white flecks...between those lit-up houses...she notices what appears to be small figures of her and her companions. But they look different. {i}Older.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她凝视着球内——在那些白色的碎屑之间……在那些亮着灯的房屋之间……她注意到了似乎是她和同伴们的小小身影。可它们看起来不一样。{i}更年长{/i}。

lines.en: scene mroomdnd36
: Der Krampus does not chase after. He straightens his posture. It’s the closest to human that he’s ever looked.
lines.zh: : Der Krampus 没有追上去。他挺直了身姿。这是他看起来最接近人类的一次。

lines.en: : He abandons his thoughts of the satyr’s breasts. He abandons his glee at the damage inflicted to the brute. And he locks his eyes on the halfling rogue.
lines.zh: : 他抛开了对萨堤尔胸部的念想。他抛开了对那个蛮子受伤的得意。然后,他把目光锁在了那个半身人游荡者身上。

lines.en: : {i}“Are you a good girl...or a bad girl?”{/i} he asks, snarling violently as a grin spreads across his face.
lines.zh: : {i}「你是个好女孩……还是个坏女孩?」{/i}他问道,狞笑在脸上蔓延开,同时发出凶狠的低吼。

lines.en: : I gaze back at him and smirk, pressing one of my cheeks up against the globe before winking at him.
lines.zh: : 我回望着他,坏笑一下,把一边脸颊贴在雪花球上,然后朝他眨了眨眼。

lines.en: : {i}That’s for me to know and you to find out.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这个嘛,我心里知道,你自己去猜。{/i}

lines.en: scene mroomdnd37
: Then I {i}smash{/i} it on the ground with all of my strength.
lines.zh: : 然后我用尽全身力气,把它{i}砸{/i}在地上。

lines.en: scene destt
: A blanket of endless white, purer than the snow itself, covers the party and overtakes everything.
lines.zh: 一片无尽的白,比雪本身还要纯净,笼罩了整个队伍,吞没了一切。

lines.en: : For a moment, there is nothing but silence. Silence so great that even the sounds of their labored breathing fall upon the deafest of ears.
lines.zh: 有那么一瞬间,除了寂静什么都没有。寂静如此之深,连他们艰难的呼吸声都落进了最聋的耳朵里。

lines.en: : “Is this death?” is the only thought that finds its way into each of your heads — but it’s only for a moment.
lines.zh: 「这就是死亡吗?」是唯一一个钻进你们每个人脑海的念头——但那只是一瞬间。

lines.en: : That endless white fades. And, when it does, you’re back at the inn.
lines.zh: 那片无尽的白褪去了。褪去之后,你们回到了旅店。

lines.en: : There’s an old man in a red suit...reading a story to a group of children seated in a semi-circle with their hands clasped together.
lines.zh: 有个穿红衣服的老人……正在给一群孩子读故事,孩子们围成半圆坐着,双手合十。

lines.en: : They look scared. But they also look intrigued.
lines.zh: 他们看起来很害怕。但也看起来很好奇。

lines.en: : You find each other. You realize you’ve all come back from the same place.
lines.zh: 你们找到了彼此。你们意识到,自己都是从同一个地方回来的。

lines.en: : But before any of you can muster any words at all, the old man’s voice fills the room.
lines.zh: 可在你们任何一个人挤出哪怕一个字之前,老人的声音就填满了整个房间。

lines.en: : “Are you a good girl...or a bad girl?”
lines.zh: : 「你是个好女孩……还是个坏女孩?」

lines.en: : “I have something for both.”
lines.zh: : 「两种我都有东西给你。」

lines.en: scene theend
scene black
{i}Lidearel has leveled up!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Lidearel 升级了!{/i}
